citations.assessment: Shabbat preserves both kinships and itself raises the possibility of two men called Mari bar Rachel. Yuhasin repeats the readings and cautions against treating him as the son of Issur. Keep those claims attached to their sources.

evidence.reference: Sefer Yuhasin, Treatise II, London 1857, p. 183
evidence.witness: Sefer Yuhasin ha-Shalem, London 1857 print, Daat / HebrewBooks scan

citations.assessment: The relevant Mari bar Rachel article expressly distinguishes a son of Rabbah in its Shabbat comparison.

notes.text: Shabbat and the London Yuhasin report both relations. Shabbat itself mentions the possibility of two men sharing Mari’s name.
